questionEnglish: Which plant tissue is responsible for the transportation of water and minerals from roots to leaves?
questionOdia: ଉଦ୍ଭିଦରେ ଚେରରୁ ପତ୍ର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଜଳ ଏବଂ ଖଣିଜ ଲବଣର ପରିବହନ ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ସଂଯୋଜକ କଳା (Tissue) ଦାୟୀ?
explanation: Xylem tissue (ଜାଇଲେମ୍) forms a continuous network of channels that conducts water and dissolved nutrients upward from the roots to all parts of the plant.

questionEnglish: Which plant tissue transports prepared food from the leaves to other parts of the plant?
questionOdia: ପତ୍ରରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହୋଇଥିବା ଖାଦ୍ୟକୁ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦର ଅନ୍ୟ ସମସ୍ତ ଅଂଶକୁ ପରିବହନ କରିବାରେ କେଉଁ କଳା ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?
explanation: Phloem tissue (ଫ୍ଲୋଏମ୍) is responsible for translocation, which is the transport of soluble organic food materials (like sucrose) made during photosynthesis.

questionEnglish: The loss of water in the form of water vapor from the aerial parts of a plant is called?
questionOdia: ଉଦ୍ଭିଦର ବାୟବୀୟ ଅଂଶରୁ ଜଳୀୟ ବାଷ୍ପ ଆକାରରେ ଜଳ ନିର୍ଗତ ହେବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Transpiration (ଉତ୍ସ୍ୱେଦନ) creates a suction pull (transpiration pull) inside the xylem vessels, helping in the upward movement of water in tall trees.

questionEnglish: How many chambers are there in a healthy human heart?
questionOdia: ଜଣେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ମାନବର ହୃତପିଣ୍ଡରେ କେତେଗୋଟି କୋଠରୀ (Chambers) ଥାଏ?
explanation: The human heart is divided into four chambers: two upper atria (ଅଳିନ୍ଦ) and two lower ventricles (ନିଳୟ) to prevent the mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood.

questionEnglish: Which blood vessels carry oxygenated blood away from the heart to various organs of the body?
questionOdia: କେଉଁ ରକ୍ତବାହୀ ଅମ୍ଳଜାନଯୁକ୍ତ ରକ୍ତକୁ ହୃତପିଣ୍ଡରୁ ଶରୀରର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ଅଙ୍ଗକୁ ବହନ କରିଥାଏ?
explanation: Arteries (ଧମନୀ) have thick, elastic walls and carry oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the rest of the body, with the exception of the pulmonary artery.

questionEnglish: Which blood component is responsible for the clotting of blood at the site of an injury?
questionOdia: ଶରୀରର କୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନ କଟିଗଲେ ରକ୍ତ ଜମାଟ ବାନ୍ଧିବାରେ ରକ୍ତର କେଉଁ ଉପାଦାନ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିଥାଏ?
explanation: Platelets (ଅଣୁଚକ୍ରିକା) circulate in the blood and clump together to form a clot at injury sites, preventing excessive bleeding.

questionEnglish: What is the instrument used to measure the blood pressure of a human being called?
questionOdia: ମାନବ ଶରୀରର ରକ୍ତଚାପ (Blood Pressure) ମାପିବା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହେଉଥିବା ଯନ୍ତ୍ରର ନାମ କଣ?
explanation: A sphygmomanometer is a device used by medical professionals to measure systolic and diastolic blood pressure levels.

questionEnglish: What is the normal systolic and diastolic blood pressure range for a healthy adult human?
questionOdia: ଜଣେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିର ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ରକ୍ତଚାପ (Systolic/Diastolic) କେତେ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
explanation: A normal blood pressure reading is 120 mm Hg for systolic pressure (heart contraction phase) and 80 mm Hg for diastolic pressure (heart relaxation phase).

questionEnglish: Which blood group is known as the 'Universal Donor' because it can be given to a person of any blood group?
questionOdia: କେଉଁ ରକ୍ତ ସମୂହକୁ 'ସର୍ବଜନୀନ ଦାତା' (Universal Donor) କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Blood Group O contains no A or B antigens on red blood cells, which prevents an immune response, allowing it to be transfused into any recipient safely.

questionEnglish: What is the fluid portion of blood left after the removal of blood cells called?
questionOdia: ରକ୍ତ କଣିକାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବାଦ୍ ଦେଲା ପରେ ରକ୍ତର ତରଳ ଅଂଶକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Plasma (ପ୍ଲାଜ୍ମା ବା ରକ୍ତ ରସ) makes up about 55% of the total blood volume and carries proteins, glucose, mineral ions, hormones, and carbon dioxide.
